criteria.criterion: rebar uses an s3://bucket/prefix value of sync.remote as a working ticket-store remote — init/mount, create, claim, transition, and the push/fetch reconcile path all succeed against it — with ticket data residing only in the SSE-KMS-encrypted bucket (never in GitHub). Verified by an opt-in live integration test.

When sync.remote resolves to an s3:// URL and the git-remote-s3 helper is absent or below the pinned minimum, store init and push fail closed with one actionable message naming the exact pip install. Verified by a CLI subprocess test.

The multiple-bundles state self-heals non-interactively by merge: after the heal, git ls-remote returns exactly one bundle for the ref, a fresh clone succeeds, and every commit/event from all divergent heads is reachable from the healed tip (no head or event discarded). Verified by a real-git-repo test.

An operator can enable and configure the S3 backend from the documentation alone: the optional [s3] dependency, the minimum helper version, SSE-KMS bucket + CMK/IAM setup, and the sync.remote=s3://… configuration are documented. Verified by the docs child's acceptance checks.
